content.short: GiveStation is a give-to-earn grant DAO that rewards contributors for public goods.
content.description: Contributors should be empowered by recurring incentives that reflect the value they create and the level of impact they achieve. Crowdfunding relies on contributors as its backbone, and web3 provides the tools needed to address this challenge once and for all. GiveStation is focused on rewarding and safeguarding contributors while maintaining accountability so that funds entrusted to founders and teams are spent in ways that align with the project’s goals and community expectations.
content.meta: GiveStation is a grant DAO that rewards contributors who support public goods. Discover GiveStation and other DAOs on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
